name: When should I consider a full kitchen remodel instead of a minor update?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider a full kitchen remodel instead of a minor update?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider a full kitchen remodel if your current kitchen has significant functional issues, an inefficient layout, or outdated infrastructure like plumbing or electrical systems. A full remodel is also ideal if you desire a completely new aesthetic, wish to expand the space, or need to address structural problems. Minor updates are better for cosmetic changes when the underlying structure and layout are satisfactory.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider a full kitchen remodel for significant functional issues, inefficient layouts, outdated infrastructure, or a desire for a complete aesthetic and structural change.
